name: atom
title: Add CSS State to Atom
description: Adds or updates pseudo-states and the is-active class state on an existing Atom. Pair active and is-active for a shared action-atom skin.

settings.name: state
settings.title: State
settings.description: hover, active, is-active, focus, focus-visible, focus-within, disabled, checked, or visited. Use active, is-active to share one rule. Colon/dot prefixes are accepted.

settings.name: styles
settings.title: Styles
settings.description: CSS declarations or a JSON property/value object.
